g.text: Bubble-point input is a liquid composition; dew-point input is a vapor composition
Same hypothetical fixed-T saturation pressures as figure762: A100/B40 kPa; ideal Raoult-law liquid and ideal vapor. These are pressure calculations. At
fixed pressure, temperature bubble/dew calculations instead solve temperature-dependent saturation-pressure relations. A liquid x and vapor y with equal
numeric values are not the same physical feed condition.
